name: ui-ux-audit
description: Three-phase UI/UX and accessibility auditing (Figma design, UI code, running app via Argent) with guided intake, a choosable audit scope, WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 A-AAA conformance reporting, reproducible scoring, an adversarial verification gate, and a themed HTML/PDF report (plus an executive cut) with screenshots taken through the MCP and marked at the finding.
